# Santi Universe (Santi U)

> Santi Universe is a web design, graphic design and AI engineering studio based in Roodepoort, South Africa, with a footprint in Kenya and clients worldwide. We build fast, high-performance websites, brand identities, AI solutions and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) that turn visitors into customers.

## Services
- [Web Design & Development](https://santi.co.za/services.html#web): business sites, eCommerce, custom web apps, landing pages.
- [Graphic Design & Branding](https://santi.co.za/services.html#branding): logos, brand identity, guidelines, marketing collateral.
- [AI Engineering](https://santi.co.za/services.html#ai): chatbots, automation, RAG assistants, API & model integration.
- [AEO — Answer Engine Optimization](https://santi.co.za/aeo.html): get found and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and AI search.
- [Web Hosting](https://santi.co.za/services.html#hosting): managed, fast, secure hosting.
- [WordPress & Plugins](https://santi.co.za/services.html#wordpress): custom development, including a booking plugin.

- [GLNI](https://santi.co.za/project-glni.html): Website & ongoing care — International leadership network.
- [Guildco](https://santi.co.za/project-guildco.html): Brand identity & website — Construction & mining.
- [Isiphethu](https://santi.co.za/project-isiphethu.html): Visual identity & brand guidelines — Engineering & water services.
- [S.H.E Foundation](https://santi.co.za/project-she.html): Visual identity — Strength, Hope & Empowerment.
- [Latroforce](https://santi.co.za/project-latroforce.html): Rebrand proposal — Management services.
- [Slice Republic](https://santi.co.za/project-slice-republic.html): Brand identity concept — Pizzeria · Identity exploration.
